title: Event
description: An event of the journal, one JSON line per event in the output of `gentry events --json`.

seq.description: Event number: grows on the machine without gaps in the order of writing. A client resumes reading after the last number it has processed.

time.description: Time in UTC, RFC 3339 with milliseconds.

type.description: Event type as object.action in the past tense, such as task.taken.

project.description: Project the event belongs to; absent for events without a project, such as a change of a setting for all projects.

task.description: Task the event belongs to; absent for events without a task.

data.description: Details of the event; each type defines its own schema.
